summary: Headless Chromium (Playwright 1.56.1) against `streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1` with provider 'fake' (4 s delay) on the four-document test fixture corpus, token mode with throwaway fake accounts. Not the team host, not the real corpus, no paid call.

steps.step: Login with a wrong token shows the generic failure; a consultant (kim) sees only the consultant page
Select the PDF project, ask; the submit button is disabled while the request runs
A second session (lee) sees the reservation in its sidebar while kim's call runs (warm server)
steps.outcome: passed: nonzero pending seen 260 ms after submit

steps.step: Change the selection while the 4 s fake call is in flight: the late answer does not attach; it remains in history
Ask on another PDF, open evidence E1: quote, neighbouring elements, page, review state, original download
Narrow layout keeps reading order (strip, search, cards, selection, answer)
Two-document comparison: both documents contribute claims
Basic information comparison: conflict and unknown states shown, no paid call
Quarantined HWP: unavailable reason shown; requirement list reports 원문 미수집
Consultant deep links /verify, /admin, /review: reload asks for login; after login no privileged content
Verifier: free trace frozen under a run ID; second run with 1 evidence unit; comparison shows the limits change
Owner records a $16 external adjustment on the admin page (audited)
At the cap: consultant sees the exhaustion warning; paid answer blocked; original download still works (bytes equal the managed original)
Six members in six browser contexts submit at once against a cold server (fake delay 4 s)
steps.outcome: passed: all six answered in 9.6 s; each saw only its own answer; every sidebar showed the shared $0.0071 reservation 5.4-5.6 s after submit (cold index load)

steps.step: Reload all six pages and keep polling 8 s
steps.outcome: passed: attempts stayed 6 settled, requests stayed 6

steps.step: Keyboard: Tab from the page start reaches a labelled input
steps.outcome: partial: focus reached an input; full keyboard walkthrough and contrast measurement not done

observations: A browser reload starts a new Streamlit session and asks for login again (the session ID is deliberately not put in the URL).
Headless Chromium reports the download's suggested name as 'download'; the bytes equal the managed original. Check the Korean filename in a real desktop browser.

Fixture-only retrieval note (phase 2 policy, unchanged): '좌석 예약 시스템은 무엇인가요?' on the one-chunk 도서관 fixture returns insufficient evidence because the restated title terms are dropped and '시스템' has non-positive IDF in the four-document corpus; no paid call is made.
